english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an identifying characteristic, including an inherited or acquired feature.
Use this for a distinguishing feature, especially one that identifies a person or thing.

examples.english: The most obvious trait of this butterfly is the red spots on its wings.
examples.traditional: 呢種蝴蝶最明顯嘅特徵係對翼有幾粒紅點。
